name: placeroot
description: Ground AI agents in open map data. MCP server for Overture Maps — compact answers, no API key.
long_description: PlaceRoot answers spatial questions from the Overture Maps public data release — nearby places, geocoding, admin hierarchy, buildings, land use, isochrones and routing — with no API key, no signup and no vendor platform. Every tool returns a compact, ranked answer sized for an agent's context window instead of a raw GeoJSON dump, and every place carries its Overture GERS id so an agent can hold onto it across turns.

tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Find named places, either near a point or inside an area's boundary.

tools.name: summarize_area
tools.description: Summarize what's in an area: total places and top categories.

tools.name: place_details
tools.description: One place, in full: addresses, websites, phones, socials, brand, source attribution, GERS id, confidence, and operating status.

tools.name: within_distance
tools.description: Is the nearest place matching category/name within max_distance_m of (lat, lon)?

tools.name: distance_matrix
tools.description: Straight-line (great-circle) distance in meters between every origin and destination.

tools.name: compare_areas
tools.description: Compare 2-5 areas side by side: category mix, density, and what differs.

tools.name: admin_lookup
tools.description: Containing admin hierarchy for a point: neighborhood up to country.

tools.name: summarize_buildings
tools.description: Summarize building footprints in an area: count, footprint area, height/floor coverage, mix.

tools.name: buildings_at
tools.description: Nearest building footprints to a point, nearest first.

tools.name: land_use_at
tools.description: What kind of land is this: land use and land cover classification at a point.

tools.name: infrastructure_at
tools.description: Infrastructure near a point, nearest first: bridges, towers, piers — and street furniture.

tools.name: water_near
tools.description: Water near a point, nearest first: waterfront check, distance to river/canal/lake.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Free-text place name -> ranked candidate locations, from Overture divisions and places.

tools.name: geocode_batch
tools.description: Geocode up to 20 free-text queries in one call, one best match each.

tools.name: search_categories
tools.description: Free text -> valid Overture category slugs, for find_places'/ summarize_area's `category` param.

tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Free-text place reference -> ranked, typed GERS ids to hold onto.

tools.name: resolve_place_batch
tools.description: Resolve up to 25 GERS ids to compact place rows in one call.

tools.name: reverse_geocode
tools.description: Point -> nearest address (street/number/postcode) and its containing division chain.

tools.name: reverse_geocode_batch
tools.description: Reverse-geocode many points in one call, to cut N round-trips down to one.

tools.name: address_at
tools.description: Nearest street addresses to a point, nearest first: number, street, unit, postcode.

tools.name: geocode_address
tools.description: Street address -> coordinates: "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View".

tools.name: simplify_geometry
tools.description: Simplify a GeoJSON geometry to fit a token budget, reporting what was lost.

tools.name: render_map
tools.description: Render find_places/summarize_area JSON (or caller-supplied GeoJSON) as a map.

tools.name: isochrone
tools.description: Isochrone: the area reachable from (lat, lon) within `minutes`, by mode.

tools.name: route
tools.description: Route: shortest-path distance and duration between two points, by mode.

tools.name: gers_lookup
tools.description: Resolve any GERS id to its entity — place, division, or building — across Overture themes.

tools.name: places_along_route
tools.description: Places on the way from A to B: corridor search along the route, ranked by detour.

tools.name: optimize_route
tools.description: Best order to visit several stops: multi-stop route ordering (a small TSP).

tools.name: data_version
tools.description: Which Overture Maps release backs the answers from every other tool.
